purpose: A non-destructive alternate cut for all 35 source-linked Ruwaidix publication and essay films.
visual_policy: Preserve every source image; published research figures are shown unzoomed and without numerical animation. Drawings and overlays are overtly marked as explanatory reconstructions, not measured data. Patient imagery must not be fabricated.
audio_policy: Open Kokoro ONNX narrator; spoken pronunciations require direct human audition, not automatic certification.
